answer: Make each new identity buy a non-transferable admission ticket whose price doubles for every other ticket issued from the same proof-of-work lineage in a 24-hour window, then vest that ticket as slashable stake for 16 epochs. A farm minting a hundred sockpuppets from one lineage pays an exponential fee and still risks a cluster slash if their work patterns match. The velvet rope is the doubling schedule itself; anyone can audit the public mesa of lineage tickets, and an orchard of peer-attested work roots exposes clones before they vote or grade.
